exposure: Diagnosis of obstructed supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection (TAPVC)
cohort: A single fetus diagnosed with supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection (TAPVC) at 23 weeks gestation, with evidence of obstruction.
finding: A rare case of prenatally diagnosed obstructed supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection at 23 weeks gestation was successfully corrected with immediate postnatal surgery, leading to excellent short-term outcomes and resolution of pulmonary artery hypertension.
